'''Matija Gogala''' (born December 11, 1937) is a [[Slovenes|Slovene]] [[entomologist]], working mainly in the fields of [[insect]] [[bioacoustics]], [[physiology]], and [[Taxonomy (biology)|taxonomy]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=prof. dr. Matija GOGALA |url=https://www2.arnes.si/~ljprirodm3/gogala.html |access-date=2025-07-13 |website=www2.arnes.si}}</ref>

He studied [[biology]] at the [[University of Ljubljana]] where he graduated in 1960 and became an assistant at the Department of biology (Biotechnical faculty). He received his doctorate in 1964. Later, he became a [[Docent#University docents|docent]] at the department and began teaching animal physiology. He obtained full [[professor]]ship in 1981.

In the meantime, he worked at the [[National Institute of Biology]] in Ljubljana, where he served as a director between 1976 and 1979. In 1987, he began working at [[Slovenian Museum of Natural History]] and served also as its director between 1992 and 2001. In 1991, he became an associate, and in 1999 a full member of the [[Slovenian Academy of Sciences and Arts]], currently serving as its vice president. Gogala is also a member of several international scientific committees and boards and the president of the [[Global Biodiversity Information Facility]] board for Slovenia.

His son, [[Andrej Gogala]], is also an entomologist.

==Scientific work==
Gogala's work focuses mainly on [[physiology]] and [[behaviour]] of different insect groups. At the University of Ljubljana, he researched seasonal [[biological pigment|pigmentation]] and physiology of insect [[sensory organ]]s. 

After that, he began working on [[seismic communication|vibrational communication]] of [[Heteroptera|bugs]], contributing pioneering work in the field of [[biotremology]].<ref>{{cite journal |last1=Hill |first1=Peggy S.M. |last2=Wessel |first2=Andreas |year=2016 |title=Biotremology |journal=Current Biology |volume=26 |issue=5 |pages=R187–R191 |doi=10.1016/j.cub.2016.01.054 |pmid=26954435|doi-access=free }}</ref> His current work focuses on sound production in [[cicada]]s and its use in the group's taxonomy.<ref>{{cite web| last=Simon |first=Chris | authorlink = Chris Simon (biologist) |year=2015 |title=The Current Status of Cicada Taxonomy on a Region-by-Region Basis |url=http://hydrodictyon.eeb.uconn.edu/projects/cicada/taxonomy/current_taxo.php |work=Cicada Central |publisher=Ecology and Evolutionary Biology, University of Connecticut |accessdate=2016-04-14}}</ref>
